text: Our two bakeries supply three cafés every morning. The Riverside bakery can bake up to 120 loaves and the Hilltop bakery up to 80. Café Blue wants 70 loaves, Café Green 60 and Café Rose 50. Delivering a loaf from Riverside costs 0.40 to Café Blue, 0.55 to Café Green and 0.70 to Café Rose; from Hilltop it costs 0.65 to Café Blue, 0.35 to Café Green and 0.45 to Café Rose. Plan deliveries to keep the delivery bill as small as possible.

Three plants (Leeds, Bristol and Glasgow) make pallets for four depots: North, South, East and West. Leeds can produce 1,500 pallets, Bristol 1,200 and Glasgow 900. Each depot must receive at least its order: North 800, South 1,100, East 700 and West 600. Shipping costs per pallet are Leeds→North £4, Leeds→South £7, Leeds→East £6, Leeds→West £8; Bristol→North £9, Bristol→South £3, Bristol→East £5, Bristol→West £4; Glasgow→North £2, Glasgow→South £10, Glasgow→East £8. Glasgow has no route to West. The lane from Bristol to South can carry at most 900 pallets. What is the cheapest plan?

We have four machines and four jobs. Machine M1 takes 14 minutes for job J1, 5 for J2, 8 for J3 and 7 for J4. M2 takes 2, 12, 6 and 5 minutes for J1 to J4. M3 takes 7, 8, 3 and 9. M4 takes 2, 4, 6 and 10. Each machine does one job and each job goes to one machine. Minimise the total processing time.

Three volunteers, Ana, Ben and Chloe, sign up for two stalls at the fair: the book stall and the food stall. The food stall needs two people and the book stall needs one. Ana rates the book stall 9 and the food stall 6; Ben rates them 4 and 8; Chloe rates them 7 and 7. Everyone works one stall. Maximise the total rating.

A cooperative sells apples from two orchards, North Orchard (300 crates) and South Orchard (250 crates), to three shops. Shop A will take exactly 200 crates, Shop B exactly 150 and Shop C exactly 120. The profit per crate is 5 from North Orchard to Shop A, 6 to Shop B and 4 to Shop C; from South Orchard it is 7 to Shop A, 3 to Shop B and 5 to Shop C. Choose shipments that maximise total profit.

Two warehouses serve two hospitals with oxygen cylinders. Warehouse East holds 60 cylinders and Warehouse West holds 45. Mercy Hospital needs 50 and General Hospital needs 40. It costs $12 to move a cylinder from Warehouse East to Mercy Hospital and $20 to General Hospital. From Warehouse West the cost is $18 to Mercy Hospital and $9 to General Hospital. No more than 30 cylinders may travel from Warehouse West to General Hospital. Minimize the transport cost.

Assign three interns to three projects so the total learning score is as high as possible. Priya would score 6 on Search, 9 on Payments and 4 on Mobile. Tom would score 8 on Search, 5 on Payments and 7 on Mobile. Wei would score 5 on Search, 6 on Payments and 9 on Mobile. Every intern gets exactly one project and every project gets one intern.

Four couriers cover three delivery zones. Zone Central needs two couriers; Zone Harbour and Zone Airport need one each. Each courier covers at most one zone. Daily cost in rupees: Arjun costs 900 in Zone Central, 1,100 in Zone Harbour and 1,300 in Zone Airport. Bela costs 950 in Zone Central and 1,000 in Zone Harbour; Bela cannot work in Zone Airport. Chen costs 1,200 in Zone Central, 1,150 in Zone Harbour and 1,000 in Zone Airport. Dev costs 1,000 in Zone Central, 1,250 in Zone Harbour and 1,100 in Zone Airport. Keep the total daily cost as low as possible.
